topic: Payroll withholding makes a new job's first paycheck feel smaller than the salary implied, and almost nobody explains why in advance
title: Why Your First Paycheck Is Smaller Than You Think
description:
You got the job and the salary offer, but your first paycheck feels wrong. It's not a mistake, it's a system designed to pay the government before you see a dime.

#paycheck #withholding #taxes #firstjob #personalfinance
